notes.title: Let There Be Light!
notes.notes:
The default lighting in Doom Roller has been increased. To increase it further click on the game's settings menu icon on the top right of the screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038171/ff5d5b18f0f3945e5f3422dcbed38269e49bf19d.png[/img]

Then click on the light bulb icon to increase the light further. Clicking on the light bulb icon a second time will set the lighting back to levels when the game started.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038171/ed044dd494a6525aeed0cff59fd1602db8d35deb.png[/img]

notes.title: Upate Notes For September 2024
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that prevented the timer from being reset when the player advanced to the next level.

notes.title: Release Update Patch
notes.notes:
Doom Roller is live and received its first update. This update did the following:

1. Aimed to improve the animation and glow of the Doom Orb's
2. Increased the speed added to the player ball when clicked on
3. Added additional game levels

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038171/6ee324c13a3c35642b01b54d8dbd1aeef8d9fe27.png[/img]
